annotations.text:
HandsFreeOS Milestone 4: the Assistant. Same system as Milestones 1 to 3 (clean & airy, accent #2D69D8, Hanken Grotesk). Ask HandsFreeOS sits under the search box in the sidebar (⌘J) and opens a panel beside the page, so it knows who you are looking at. On phones it is the H button in the top bar and opens full screen.
Try the Main screen: pick a suggestion or type “What needs attention?”, “Create a task for Priya to call Sarah tomorrow”, “Move Mike to Won”, “Text Mike…” or “How many leads this week?”. The answers are scripted samples; the real ones come from Claude Sonnet 5 and your data.
Sample data only: Lone Star HVAC & Roofing is a fictional client workspace of Go Biz Help. People, phone numbers and messages are placeholders.

Phone: the H button opens the Assistant full screen over the page, and X returns to it. It opens here on the empty state; switch Preview to “conversation” to see answers and a confirmation card. Buttons inside cards grow to 44 px so they are easy to tap.

What runs on its own: looking things up, tasks and notes (both with Undo). What asks first: texts, emails, moving or changing leads, adding or changing customers. A card left unanswered expires when you ask something else.
The Assistant can only do what the signed-in person can do. Everything it changes shows in the audit log as done by that person, through the Assistant. Chats are private to each person.
